Problem Statement:
Given 2 strings.check if the second string is a substring of the first string.Print 'yes' if there exists a valid substring otherwise print 'no'.
input_spec: The input consists of two strings. The size of the strings (N) is between 1 and 100000 (inclusive).
output_spec: Print 'yes' if the second string is a substring of the first string, otherwise print 'no'.
